# LobeHub

> > LobeHub is an open-source AI agent collaboration platform supporting Claude, GPT-4o, DeepSeek, and local models with marketplace integrations for skills and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.

LobeHub enables users to build, customize, and deploy AI agent teammates with multimodal capabilities, knowledge bases, and workflow automation. The platform offers self-hosting options via Docker, Vercel, and other platforms, plus cloud subscriptions with compute credits for major LLM providers.

## Key Topics

- AI Agents & Agent Builder
- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Claude, GPT-4o, DeepSeek integration
- Agent Marketplace & Skills Marketplace
- Self-hosting with Docker & Vercel
- Multimodal AI & Knowledge Bases
- LLM Integration (OpenAI, Ollama, Hunyuan)
- Agent Collaboration & Workflow Automation
- Next.js & Open-source Development
- S3 Storage & Vector Embeddings
- Docker Compose Deployment
- Cross-platform (macOS, Windows, Linux)
- Developer Tools & Ecosystem

## Getting Started

- [LobeHub Homepage](https://lobehub.com): Main homepage for LobeHub's agent collaboration platform
- [Introduction](https://lobehub.com/docs/usage/start): Introduction to LobeHub's agent platform and core concepts
- [Agent Builder Guide](https://lobehub.com/docs/usage/getting-started/agent): Guide to creating and configuring agents with skills and knowledge
- [Downloads](https://lobehub.com/downloads): Download LobeHub for macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android
- [About LobeHub](https://lobehub.com/about): LobeHub's mission to make AI accessible through open-source tools
- [Plans & Pricing](https://lobehub.com/pricing): Subscription plans with GPT-4o, Claude, and Gemini compute credits

## Marketplaces

- [Agent Skills Marketplace](https://lobehub.com/skills): Browse and install agent skills compatible with Claude and ChatGPT
- [MCP Servers Marketplace](https://lobehub.com/mcp): Model Context Protocol servers for browser automation and integrations

## Self-Hosting & Deployment

- [Self-Hosting Overview](https://lobehub.com/docs/self-hosting/start): Self-hosting guide with Vercel, Docker, Zeabur, and other platforms
- [Docker Compose Deployment](https://lobehub.com/docs/self-hosting/platform/docker-compose): Docker Compose deployment guide for LobeHub server database version
- [S3 Storage Configuration](https://lobehub.com/docs/self-hosting/advanced/s3): S3 storage configuration for multimodal AI with Amazon, Cloudflare R2

## LLM Provider Integrations

- [DeepSeek Integration](https://lobehub.com/docs/usage/providers/deepseek): Configure DeepSeek-V3 and DeepSeek-R1 models in LobeHub
- [Ollama Integration](https://lobehub.com/docs/usage/providers/ollama): Run Llama 2, Mistral, and other LLMs locally with Ollama integration
- [SenseTime SenseNova](https://lobehub.com/docs/usage/providers/sensenova): Setup guide for SenseTime SenseNova API integration in LobeHub
- [Tencent Hunyuan](https://lobehub.com/docs/usage/providers/hunyuan): Configure Tencent Hunyuan API for intelligent assistant conversations

## Support & Resources

- [Help & Support](https://lobehub.com/docs/usage/help): Help resources, community channels, and contact information
- [Resources Hub](https://lobehub.com/resources): Docs, guides, and community resources for LobeHub users
- [FAQ: Insufficient Credits](https://lobehub.com/docs/usage/faq/calculating-credits-are-insufficient): FAQ on handling insufficient calculation credits in LobeHub Cloud
- [FAQ: Vector Storage](https://lobehub.com/docs/usage/faq/how-is-vector-storage-calculated): FAQ explaining vector storage calculation for embeddings in LobeHub Cloud

## Developer Reference

- [Development Resources](https://lobehub.com/docs/development/basic/resources): Development resources including OpenAI API, AI SDK, and ecosystem tools
